parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description:
The domain names of the websites. You can specify the domain names of up to 200 websites.

>  A forwarding rule must be configured for a domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-cname-reuses --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
